import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*np.exp(-t))
    amp = p[4] + p[5]*t + p[6]*t**2
    k = np.exp(p[7] + p[8]*t + p[9]*t**2)
    return base + amp*np.exp(-k*np.abs(A)**(-1.5))
